desc: 象牙雾底与松枝灰绿的夏日家用喷雾花露水详情页
name: 雾松灰绿夏日清香花露水款

shots.intent: 在详情首屏用一瓶立于低雾与叶影间的安静画面换一眼停留
shots.textZone: 左上竖排两行宋体标题，其下两枚细线方框图记与两枚空白方形徽标位

shots.intent: 把夏夜开窗通风难以安坐的普遍困扰拍成可见画面，承接首屏停留
shots.textZone: 顶部三分之一留白带放一行痛点标题，其下两枚细线方框标签位

shots.intent: 用一行方框图记把四条核心承诺摊成可扫读的第一层信任，文案全部交给占位
shots.textZone: 四枚方框下方各一条细线标签位，左角一枚空标题位

shots.intent: 以压泵与雾束微距证明喷头工艺与出雾状态，撑起质感信任
shots.textZone: 底部一条细线标签位，其余不写字

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实夏夜卧房语境，让买家代入自家床头
shots.textZone: 上方留白带放核心利益标题，右下两枚细线方框标签位

shots.intent: 用左右两栏并列把两条主用语境摊开对照，帮买家自己对号入座
shots.textZone: 左右面板各一行宋体标题与一条空白标签位，底部一条深绿封带

shots.intent: 把三条产品自述机制压成一屏细读清单，内容全部交给占位不写事实
shots.textZone: 右侧三行细线清单各配一枚方框图记与一行标题位

shots.intent: 把便携语境拍成包边一隅，补足居家之外的使用想象
shots.textZone: 右侧留白带放一行标题与一枚方框标签位

shots.intent: 以留白参数单的诚实版式做信任收口，真实数值全部由商家后期合成
shots.textZone: 五行参数左侧留标签位、右侧留空白值域

shots.intent: 以一瓶仰视剪影压进深绿封带收束全页，行动文案与承诺全部留占位
shots.textZone: 深绿封带内一行主标题与一枚暖铜描边按钮位，两侧各一枚方框标签位

style.backgroundSystem: flat matte ivory paper field #F7F3EA carrying at most one dried-sage panel band #A8BC9B, a low drifting fog ribbon at the base and cast leaf shadows only, deep pine green #22412F reserved for footer bands; never a cold blue or mint sky field, never water, splash, foam or tropical palm fronds
style.iconSystem: hairline-outlined square frames, one pictogram per frame drawn solid in dried-sage #A8BC9B or deep pine #22412F, frames joined by hairline rules into a row or a ledger, no circles, no medallions, no bubbles, no wavy bands, no pill ladder
style.lightingSystem: soft warm-neutral side light from the upper right at about 4700K with a backlit rim along the bottle edge, longer soft shadows falling to the lower left, low contrast, one grounding contact shadow, no hard specular and no cold blue fill
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent calm apothecary-botanical household repellent-lotion commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ivory paper white #F7F3EA, dried-sage green #A8BC9B and deep pine green #22412F with one warm copper accent #B0762F and dark moss text #26312A; neutral warm-leaning temperature, never a cold blue field; every backdrop is a flat matte ivory paper field #F7F3EA carrying at most one dried-sage panel band #A8BC9B, a low drifting fog ribbon at the base and cast leaf shadows only, with deep pine green #22412F reserved for footer bands, and never sky, water, splash, foam or palm fronds; soft warm-neutral side light from the upper right at about 4700K with a backlit rim on the bottle edge, longer soft shadows falling to the lower left, low contrast, one grounding contact shadow, no hard speculars; typography is one high-contrast Song-style serif used for every Chinese headline and label, letterspaced, wrapped in 「」 at 20-40pt, separated by hairline rules rather than coloured pills, no dense body copy; icon system is one hairline-outlined square frame holding one solid dried-sage pictogram, frames joined by hairline rules into a row or a ledger, with no circles, no medallions, no bubbles and no pill ladders; the bottle stays upright at a stable scale with its white pump-sprayer collar, straight cylindrical shoulder, yellow-to-green liquid gradient and lower label band unchanged, the front label kept as a completely blank legible field with no rendered words; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers, dates, durations or claims.
noDrift: no protection-duration, overnight or hours wording anywhere, no clock, dial, countdown or time numerals
no repellent, kill or bite-reduction percentages, no purity percentages, no ingredient names or quantities
no cure, treatment, anti-itch, disinfect or sterilise wording, no raw, scratched or broken skin in frame
no test, lab, dermatology or skin-irritation wording, no chart shapes implying measured results
no age indication, no infant or child figure, no unsupervised-child usage scene
no pesticide or health registration numbers, no licence, certification marks, seals, awards or QR codes
no volumes, millilitre figures, shelf-life years, ratios or digits rendered on any spec row
no person applying the product to skin, no spray directed at face, eyes or mouth
no cold blue or mint sky fields, no water splash arcs, no palm-frond tropical cues, no red promotional hues
no mixed fonts and no icon drift: circles, bubbles, medallions and pill ladders stay out; the front label stays a blank legible field
style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright at a stable scale with its white pump-sprayer collar, straight cylindrical shoulder, yellow-to-green liquid gradient and lower label band unchanged and centred, front label always a blank legible field with no rendered words, props placed behind or beside the silhouette and never crossing it
style.surfaceSystem: matte ivory plaster ledge and pale stone shelf, rumpled oat linen at the bedside, one low fog ribbon pooling at the base of the bottle; no water surface, no ripples, no glossy podium
style.typography: one high-contrast Song-style serif family for every Chinese headline and label, letterspaced and wrapped in 「」 at 20-40pt in dark moss #26312A, separated by hairline rules instead of coloured pills or blocks, no dense body copy
